record.oneLiner: Web data platform offering scraper, SERP, unlocker, browser and proxy APIs, with an official MCP server.
record.verdictReason: Every account gets a default API token and 5,000 free credits per month, so the core APIs can be used self-serve. The docs do not use the term REST, so apiType rest is inferred from HTTP POST endpoints with a Bearer token. The free-tier figures differ across Bright Data pages, so the current offer should be checked in the account.

evidence.quote: We create a default key for you upon account creation automatically.
Every Bright Data account gets 5,000 free credits per month, and the MCP server draws from them.
Authentication, endpoints, SDKs and the CLI.
The Bright Data MCP server only requires an API token, for both the remote (hosted) and local (self-hosted) setup.
